description: FIREWALL BREACH (a Nest event the Games Master can draw, 6 hours): read the hunt. A leaked ledger passphrase of 6 codewords is torn into fragments, one released per hour, each found in a different district. Shows which fragments are out (district and codeword), when the next appears, how many solved it, and the public seal hash of the answer. Read only, no token.
name: firewall_state
